Formula Audit

This page records the main documentation checks performed against the current implementation in src/.

Audited Areas

AreaChecked againstNotes
Albedosrc/processes/albedo.jlDynamic snowfall refresh and liquid-water adjustment documented from code.
Accumulation / meltsrc/processes/accumulation.jl, src/processes/melt.jlInternal helpers documented as internals, not as nonexistent public APIs.
Layer structuresrc/processes/layer_structure.jlBasal depletion and fixed 15-layer BESSI reference cap documented from code.
Densificationsrc/processes/densification.jlLow-, mid-, and high-density branches checked against implementation constants.
Energy balancesrc/processes/energy_flux.jl, src/processes/surface_fluxes.jl, src/processes/diurnal_shortwave.jlSurface-flux coefficients and the implicit solve now follow the current code path.
Percolationsrc/processes/percolation.jlDefault max_lwc = 0.1 and pore-volume routing behavior updated.
Refreezingsrc/processes/refreezing.jlPartial and complete refreezing branches documented from the implemented update formulas.

Notable Drift Corrections

  • Older docs described go_percolation! with max_lwc = 0.05; the current implementation uses 0.1.
  • Older percolation notes described a dense-layer rho_i_tol retention rule. The current implementation instead routes water when pore volume collapses, and rho_i_tol is presently accepted by the signature but not used.
  • Older energy docs mentioned a tridiagonal_solver option. The current implementation uses the Thomas algorithm directly.
  • The current energy and precipitation-heat implementation uses rate-based coefficients from snowfall_rate and rainfall_rate directly; the older docs had an extra rho_w factor that is not present in code.
  • The public accumulation and melt entry points are step! and the higher level case API. _apply_accumulation! and _apply_melt! are documented here as key internals, not as exported user APIs.
